content: Isra7eele Deraa Dawiti Qoodiseth
Xala7ey Isra7eele asaa bolla meto ehanaas koyidi Dawiti Isra7eele asaa qoodana mala denththeththides.
Dawiti Iyo7aabenne olanchchata halaqata, «Daaneppe biidi Bersaabehe gakkanaas diza Isra7eele asaa qoodite; histtidi asaa qooday aappunakko tana erisite» gides.

Iyo7aabey gidikko izas, «GODAY ha7i diza Isra7eele asaa bolla xeetu kushe gujjo! Ta godaa kawoo! istti ubbay ta godaa aylleta deettennee? Ta goday hayssa mala ooththanaas ays koyidee? Isra7eele kawoteththaa ays mooranchcha kessizee?» gides.
Gido attiin kawoza qaalay Iyo7aabe xoonides; histtiin Iyo7aabey kezi Isra7eele biitta ubbaa yuuyi aadhdhi Yerusalaame simmides.
Iyo7aabey qoodida asaa qooda Dawites immides; Isra7eeleppe 1,100,000 Yuhudappe 47,000 olanaas dandayzayta demmides.
Iyo7aabey kawoza azazon harasettida gishshas Leweta qommotanne Biniyaame qommota qoodibeenna.
He azazozi Xoossa matan iita gidida gishshas Xoossi Isra7eele asaa qaxxaydes.
Hessafe guye Dawiti Xoossas, «Tani ha oosozan nena keeha qohadis; tani bala ooththida gishshas tana ne aylleza qoho atto gaana mala ta nena woossays» gides.
GODAY Dawite nabe Gaades,
«Baada Dawite, ‹GODAY nena tani ne doorana mala ne sinththan heedzdzu miishshata woththadis; tanikka ne dooridayssa ooththana› gides» gaada yoota.
Histtiin Gaadey Dawitekko biidi, «GODAY ne sinththan woththoyssafe issaa doora;

heedzdzu layththa kosha, woykko heedzdzu agina kumeth ne morkketan goodeteth, woykko heedzdzu gallas iita harge ehiza Xoossa mashshay biitta bolla yiin Isra7eele ubbaa bolla hayqo ehiza Xoossa kiitanchcha yuus, hessa gishshas tana kiittida Xoossaas ta ay zaara yootanaakko heytanttafe ne dooroyssa taas yoota» gides.
Dawiti Gaades, «Ta dooranaas keeha metotadis; gidikkoka Godaa Xoossa maarotay keehi gita gidida gishshas asa kushen kundanaappe Xoossa kushen kundeththi taas lo7o» gides.
Hessa gishshas GODAY iita harge yeddiin Isra7eeleppe 70,000 asi hayqqides.

Hessafe guye GODAY Yerusalaame dhayssanaas kiitanchcha kiittides; gido attiin kiitanchchazi Yerusalaame dhayssanaas shiiqi uttidaashin GODAY be7idi mishettides; dhayssana yida kiitanchchaa, «Agga! Istta bolla gakkida bashshay gidana» gides. He wode Godaa Xoossaa kiitanchchay Yaabuse dere as Orna bale matan eqqides.

Kiitanchchazi ba giththa mashsha kushen oykkidi Yerusalaame dhayssanaas saloppenne sa7appe giddon eqqidayssa Dawiti dhoqqu gi be7ides; hessafe guye Dawitinne cimati maaqa may7idi biitta bolla gufannida.

Dawiti Xoossaas, «Asay qoodettana mala ooththiday tana gidikkinaa? Nagara ooththidaynne qohiday tana; histtiin hayti dorsati ay ooththidoo? Abeet ta Godaa Xoossawu! Ne kushey ta bollanne ta keeththa asaa bolla gido attiin ha boshaza ne deraa bolla yeddofa» gides.
Hessafe guye Godaa Xoossaa kiitanchchay Gaades, «Dawiti pude Yaabuse dere as Orna bale biidi Godaa Xoossaas yarsho yarshizaso ooththana mala yoota» gi azazides.
Dawiti Gaadey Godaa Xoossaa sunththan yootoyssaththo ooththanaas bides.
He wode Ornaynne iza nayti balen gistte bukkishe guye simmi xeellidi kiitanchchaa be7ida; histtidi izara diza oyddu attuma nayti qotettida.
Dawiti Ornako yiin Ornay iza be7idi balezappe gaxa ke7idi Dawites ziggides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti Ornas, «Deraa bolla yida boshay kichchana mala tani Godaa Xoossaas yarsho yarshizaso ooththanaas ne baleza taas bayzarkkii! Tani nees kumeththa waaga qanxxana» gides.

Histtiin Ornay Dawites, «Nees ekka; ta goday kawoy bana ufayssizayssa ooththo; hekko xuugettiza yarshos boorata, eesos kath bukkiza lodata, kaththa yarsho gidana mala gistte immana; hayta ubbatakka ta nees immana» gides.

Gido attiin kawo Dawiti Ornas, «Hessi hanenna! Tani kumeththa waaga qanxxada shammana; tani neyssa coo mela ekkada Godaa Xoossaas yarsho shiishshike; qasse ta shammontta miish xuugettiza yarsho ooththa shiishshike» gides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti he balezas 600 worqqafe oosettida bira immides.

Hessafe guye Dawiti heen Godaa Xoossas yarsho yarshizaso ooththidi xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa yarsho shiishshides; izi Godaa Xoossaa woossiin xuugettiza yarsho yarshizasoza bolla saloppe tama yeddidi iza oyshaa zaarides.
Histtiin GODAY kiitanchchaa azaziin kiitanchchazi ba giththa mashshaa koohaan gelththides.
Dawiti GODAY Yaabuse dere as Orna kaththa balen izas zaaridayssa be7idi heen yarsho shiishshides.
Musey bazzon giigsida Godaa Xoossaa Dunkaaneynne xuugettida yarsho yarshizasozi Geba7oone zumbullaa bolla dees.
Dawiti Xoossa kiitanchchay oykkida giththa mashshaas yayyida gishshas hee biidi GODAA oychchanaas dandaybeenna.
